answer: The kernel schedule is applied in reef and plume exposes each instalment. A payout is split which means 21% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Anyone thus cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4264 identities would post 2814 proofs and burn roughly 49 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
